correctness.rationale: From the actual eight-file frozen Git source (tree SHA independently recomputed), every diameter-exactly-four tree has a unique center and at least two positive-depth branches. Partition its center branches by pendant-leaf count 0,1,2,≥3; in the last type retain exactly 3 leaves and in every type retain at most 3 branches. A 3-move Duplicator strategy uses a category-preserving branch/leaf matching, maps centers to centers, and reuses selected vertices, ensuring selected equality/adjacency relations match (at most three branches or leaves per branch can be exposed). Thus every unbounded tree reduces without increasing order to one of 4^4−4−12=240 canonical vectors. For a tuple of vertices define H0 as the complete atomic equality/adjacency diagram and H_{r+1}(a)={H_r(a,b): b vertex}. H3(()) is a COMPLETE rank-three invariant by the EF/Hintikka recursion, including arbitrarily many Boolean combinations. Independently implemented explicit three-vertex atomic-diagram recursion over all 240 vectors yielded exactly 9 type signatures and minimum witnesses [(5,(0,2,0,0)),(6,(0,1,1,0)),(6,(1,2,0,0)),(7,(0,0,2,0)),(7,(0,3,0,0)),(7,(1,1,1,0)),(8,(0,2,1,0)),(9,(2,0,2,0)),(10,(0,0,3,0))], exactly matching the supplied complete enumeration. Additional independent H3 comparisons on 25 large branch-multiplicity and 25 high leaf-count families matched their truncations. The sharp 10-vertex minimum extends to arbitrary trees because truncation never adds vertices. These independent finite computations certify the closed canonical census, while the symbolic 3-round EF reduction, not sampling, covers the infinite family.
residual_risks: General categorical branch-truncation strategy is presented informally rather than as a formally checked game tactic, but each adjacency/equality case is covered by the three-selection counting argument.
Computational verification depends on Python execution and correct implementation; an independent direct H3 recursion was used to reduce correlated-code risk.
No theorem is asserted at rank four, with coloured or rooted labels, or for trees of diameter at most rather than exactly four.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge, with meaningful source reading and residual risk: the exact full-class pure-adjacency rank-three quotient of all finite diameter-four trees, with nine distinct classes and sharp ten-vertex representative minimum, was not covered by the inspected general tree definability studies or published adjacent logical spectra. The novelty is not the EF theorem or canonical type recursion; it is the evaluated exact unbounded-order classification and sharp kernel. An unindexed equivalent small-rank tree table could change priority.
residual_risks: A stronger unindexed or older exact low-rank graph/tree-type table could imply the nine-class and 10-vertex results despite lack of literal matching terminology.
Full coverage of all model-theory theses/monographs is infeasible; Heuter and Bohman primary relevant material was inspected, not every page of every possible source.
Negative bibliographic search is not a proof of worldwide priority, and no independent external peer certification is claimed.

value.rationale: A natural complete finite-model-theoretic invariant is solved across an infinite class of arbitrarily large trees rather than an arbitrary small-instance census. The sharp ten-vertex kernel gives a minimal universal testing universe of nine representatives for truth/validity/satisfiability of ANY FO rank≤3 sentence restricted to diameter-exactly-four trees. The nontrivial content combines a structural EF reduction, the exact nine-class classification and a proved optimal representative-size boundary. This finite exact classification need not support a general downstream theorem to be useful for bounded-depth logical expressivity and finite model test suites.
residual_risks: Scope is a low rank and one graph diameter; does not classify unrestricted trees or stronger languages.
No claim of asymptotically better model-checking complexity or general logical depth theory follows from the nine test representatives.

limitations: C proof and exact enumeration were assessed independently; no formal prover or expert attestation was performed.
The originality finding is best-of-knowledge and retains explicit priority risks.
Publication plan is not_ready for privacy/provenance transport, not because the science failed.
